description:
Redesign this armor and BOTH ADDONS as premium RUNE SENTINEL, ALL36 sprites TOGETHER, using COMPLETE KNIGHT/WARMASTER art+mask references.
Target240x240 grid6x6 cells40px. Cols0-2: NORTH(even rows)/SOUTH(odd rows), idle/walkA/walkB. Cols3-5: EAST(even)/WEST(odd), idle/walkA/walkB.
Rows0-1=complete BASE. Rows2-3=BASE+ADDON1. Rows4-5=BASE+ADDON1+ADDON2. All cells COMPLETE worn outfits, not detached overlays.
Base garment stays SAME across matching tiers; addons must make a CLEAR visible difference at native size. Keep exact Citizen joint/face/hand/foot positions and diagonal projection. Never erase opaque body pixels or shrink the figure. Source armor is unfinished, improve it substantially.
BASE: original elite rune-guard, fitted angular open-face helmet, strong sculpted plate cuirass with LARGE inset diamond runestone, dark undersuit, bracers, overlapping angular hip armor, strong belt, solid paired greaves/boots. Broad dark/mid/light surfaces define elegant plate geometry. NOT plain Citizen shirt and NOT noisy white scribbles.
ADDON1: attached stepped REAR HELMET CREST of2-4px thickness, clearly visible. Same crest turns with head: extends UP for SOUTH, LEFT for EAST, RIGHT for WEST, DOWN for NORTH. Keep existing face/helmet seat; no floating extra head.
ADDON2: TWO conspicuous fitted tiered angular SHOULDER GUARDS plus short worked collar, linked to both shoulder roots. Near guard broad/light top/dark underside, far guard visible as perspective permits. Never floating above head, never on elbow. Learn from Warmaster shoulder construction but create original runic shapes.
Clean cohesive metal clusters with moderate contrast. No isolated white dots, confetti, scratches, dotted edges or checkerboard. Neutral grayscale armor/runes/addons, warm skin only. Same paired leg lengths and plate geometry in all poses. No copied weapons, horns, cape, flags or text.
context_usage: Authoritative COMPLETE ACTUAL TIBIA art+mask spritesheets, native pixels with no rescaling or lost parts. TOP720x360: Warmaster. Left360x360=36 full sprites in target6x6 grid (base,base+addon1,both addons, each all4 directions and3 native poses). Right360x360=exact matching four-channel masks. BOTTOM LEFT: Knight 36 full sprites in3 columns of states(base/+addon1/+both), each state3 phases horizontally and4 directions vertically: art at(0,360)396x176; matching color masks at(0,536)396x176. Target at(480,360)240x240. Study full armor wardrobe, matching rotating helmet decorations, shoulder integration and animation and pure-color mask semantics. References are existing outfits to learn structure/style, not designs/weapons to copy. Earlier armor is EDIT TARGET only. Paint base AND both addons in same pass, all headings/walks together.
